briefing: Markets were risk-on today with NASDAQ +1.1% and S&P 500 +0.8%. With 3 open slots and cash above the deployment threshold, we added DOCN and CIEN, both top-scored candidates with confirmed bullish momentum (RSI in the healthy 55-70 zone, MACD crossovers, price above SMA-20), while holding all existing positions.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-on' day is when investors broadly buy riskier assets like stocks, especially growth and tech names, because they feel confident about the economy or market direction. On these days, it often makes sense to deploy available cash into your best-confirmed opportunities rather than sitting on the sidelines.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「risk-on」（風險偏好）日是指投資者普遍買入較高風險的資產，例如股票，尤其是增長股及科技股，因為他們對經濟或市場前景感到樂觀。在這類日子，將閒置現金投入經確認的優質機會，往往比繼續持現金觀望更為合理。

market_education.summary_en: Broad-based buying lifted both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 today, with technology and growth names leading the advance. The gains reflect continued investor confidence in risk assets rather than any single catalyst. No specific news headlines were available in today's feed to cite.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市呈現普遍性買盤，納斯達克及標普500指數同步上揚，科技及增長股表現領先。此次升勢反映投資者對風險資產持續看好的情緒，而非單一事件所觸發。今日資訊來源中未有具體新聞標題可供引用。
